_comment_nullAnalysis: disabled on purpose: rke2lab's rule is that no input is ever nullable (non-null-by-default by discipline), but it isn't declared via @NonNullByDefault yet, so 'automatic' couldn't see the rule and only surfaced friction at third-party boundaries (Optional, Framework, JUnit callbacks) we can't fix. Machine-enforcing the rule is a backlog item (.claude/memory/java-cleanup-backlog.md + non-null-input-rule.md); flip back to 'automatic' the day @NonNullByDefault is declared.
_comment_targetActors: target~<actor> are per-actor Maven build outputs (target~nxmatic CLI, target~claude CLI); the IDE owns plain `target`. Keep the other actors' dirs out of the watcher/importer so a CLI build never floods FSEvents and stalls the extension host.
